title: Sunset Dreams Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Sunset Dreams is a prime location, renovated and updated luxury penthouse overlooking the Seaside Amphitheater and the Gulf! Enjoy a King primary, renovated kitchen and more, plus sleeps 4!
description_expanded: Description121 CENTRAL SQUARE, HOLL BUILDING; UNIT B-21 KING, 1 QUEEN SLEEPER SOFA (sleeps four) Sunset Dreams | Luxury Gulf-View Vacation Rental in Seaside, FloridaPerched atop the iconic, award-winning Holl Building in Dreamland Heights, Sunset Dreams is a newly introduced, beautifully renovated modern suite offering sweeping views of the Gulf of Mexico, downtown Seaside, and the vibrant Seaside Amphitheater below. Designed by renowned architect Steven Holl, this elevated Seaside vacation rental blends striking architecture with coastal comfort and accommodates up to four guests, making it ideal for couples or small families seeking a luxury stay in the heart of Seaside, Florida.Thoughtfully Designed Coastal InteriorsStep inside to an airy, coastal-inspired interior where natural light and modern finishes create an inviting retreat. The entry foyer sits beside a newly renovated half bath, setting the tone for both comfort and convenience. The first level features a spacious king primary suite with built-in storage, a dedicated desk area, a large flat-screen TV, and expansive windows that frame stunning town and Gulf views. Just steps away, the full bathroom offers a spa-like experience with a marble vanity and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower with multiple rain shower heads.Modern Kitchen & Open Living SpaceA striking spiral staircase leads to the second level, where an open-concept layout invites relaxation and entertaining. The fully renovated kitchen showcases sleek black stone countertops and premium stainless steel appliances, including a four-burner electric cooktop, full-size Sub-Zero refrigerator, microwave, dishwasher, and Keurig coffee maker. Adjacent dining seating for three flows seamlessly into the living area, which features a large flat-screen TV with soundbar, a plush sofa with a queen sleeper, and two club chairs for additional seating.Private Balcony with Panoramic Gulf ViewsThe highlight of Sunset Dreams is the private, furnished balcony, offering unobstructed views of Seaside and the sparkling Gulf just across the street. With bar seating for four, this elevated outdoor space is perfect for enjoying sunsets over the Gulf, people-watching in the town center, or catching Fourth of July and New Year’s Eve fireworks from the comfort of your suite.Unbeatable Location in the Heart of SeasideLocated just steps from Seaside’s white-sand beaches, boutique shopping, acclaimed restaurants, and live entertainment at the amphitheater, Sunset Dreams places you at the center of it all. Whether you’re here for a romantic escape, a weekend getaway, or a coastal retreat, this luxury Seaside vacation rental offers an unforgettable stay along Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A—your perfect home away from home on the Gulf Coast.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES727 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space3-minute walk (approximately 500 feet) to Coleman beach access, placing you just steps from the GulfSeaside beach access at Coleman Pavilion for a convenient and scenic entry point to the sandAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerNo washer or dryer in this unitWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities thoughtfully providedOne parking pass included; shared permit parking is located behind the Holl Building (based on availability), with additional permitted parking along Quincy CircleGolf carts are considered vehicles and are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside; special circumstances and medical needs require an approved golf cart permitNo pets allowed
